messages:
jamie.c: heads-up: rack-14 node-rt-12 reported repeated ECC spikes and Xid 62/13. GPU0 serial SNLT9X334 is the one flapping. starting drain now.
ops-bot: Auto-drain initiated for node-rt-12 at 2025-05-03T09:22Z. Workloads reprovisioning to fallback pools.
sanjay: can you paste the serials and a short log snippet? i'll check depot slots in FRA and vendor ETA.
jamie.c: serials: GPU0 SNLT9X334, GPU1 SNLT9X335. GPU0 shows intermittent PCIe reset + ECC spikes over 48h. sample logs -> `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,name,serial,error.corrected.errors.volatile -i 0 -f csv` gave repeated corrected ECC counts.
maureen: vendor portal says depot swap open but customs in FRA are flagging electronics shipments this week. clearance + courier is ~5-7bd.
dylan: we have 2 hot spares in DUB (SPARE-DUB-02, SPARE-DUB-03). handcarry from DUB to FRA would be faster than waiting on customs hold. anyone opposed?
lina: handcarry sounds fine but need proper export/import paperwork IE->DE. ops must prepare pro forma + RMA letter. @maureen can you confirm vendor accepts handcarry swaps vs depot returns?
maureen: vendor-bot: "Handcarry accepted if pre-notified and RMA reference provided" — opening RMA ref RMA-7823-HC and adding customs packet now. will notify vendor contact and attach serial list.
sanjay: if we lose 2 GPUs temporarily, training capacity drops ~4% in eu-west-1. can we push critical jobs to eu-west-2 or enable dedicated fallbacks for 24-48h?
jamie.c: enabling canary throttles on training queue and applying failover policy. updating spare-pool: marking SPARE-DUB-02 as in-transit pending handcarry.
ops-bot: Manifest updated: SPARE-DUB-02 status -> in-transit. Tracking TRK998211 created. ETA provisional 2025-05-05.
dylan: i'll take handcarry. what docs do i need to bring? passport, pro forma, vendor RMA letter, return labels?
maureen: yes. i'll DM you the PDF packet and vendor on-call. vendor requires declared value on the pro forma set to $0 for returns but include original invoice for customs. also include `old_serial -> new_serial` swap sheet signed at handover.
sanjay: after swap please post the serial mapping in Fleet DB and attach the scan in the RMA ticket. i'll run a reconciliation job to reconcile capacity and billable units. make sure `old_serial` entries are closed in inventory.
lina: add tag `expedited-handcarry` to the vendor ticket and ops manifest so we keep it on the priority dashboard.
jamie.c: noted. i'll coordinate the post-install smoke tests (memtest + 24h ECC watch) once dylan confirms install. keep vendor ticket open until return scan and confirmed successful reprovision. :thumbsup:
vendor-bot: Vendor updated RMA-7823-HC: "Accepting handcarry. Please provide ETA and signed swap sheet at handover."
